operating_notes.text: Strategic disinvestment involves the sale of a 60.72% aggregate stake by GOI and LIC.
FY26 other income includes ₹1,210.49 Cr gain from sale of NSDL stake.
Bank reduced property WDV by ₹2,121.82 Cr due to legal restrictions on sale.
Additional provision of ₹32.88 Cr made for estimated impact of new Labour Codes.
Provision Coverage Ratio (PCR) maintained above 99% since September 2023.
IDBI Foundation incorporated as a wholly owned subsidiary for CSR activities.
SEBI imposed a ₹2 lakh penalty on subsidiary IDBI Trusteeship Services Limited for regulatory non-compliance.
Promoter LIC declared nil encumbrance on its shareholding for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.
Winning bid of ₹81 per share compared with a ₹75.99 benchmark (average of two independent valuations) and a ₹94.42 reserve price set for the first round in FY26.
GoI will retain 15% and LIC 19% of IDBI Bank after the sale; both will withdraw board nominees and become public shareholders.
Q2FY27 net interest margin was 4.11% annualised versus 3.71% a year ago and 3.61% in Q1FY27.
Capital adequacy ratio was 27.22% with CET1 at 26.67% at September 30, 2026.
One stressed loan account with principal outstanding of ₹802.92 Cr was transferred for an aggregate consideration of ₹30.05 Cr during the quarter.

timeline.summary: IDBI Bank clarified that its strategic disinvestment remains a confidential process managed by the Government of India.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): interest earned ₹7,803.71 Cr (+11.8% YoY), net profit ₹2,007.12 Cr (-3.9% YoY).
IDBI Bank reported FY26 net profit of ₹9,513 Cr, up 27% YoY, with Gross NPA improving to 2.32%.
IDBI Bank board approved a ₹10,000 Cr long-term bond issuance for infrastructure and affordable housing on May 16, 2026.
IDBI Bank incorporated IDBI Foundation as a wholly owned Section 8 subsidiary for CSR initiatives on May 19, 2026.
SEBI imposed a ₹2 lakh penalty on subsidiary IDBI Trusteeship Services for non-compliance with debenture trustee regulations.
LIC declared that it maintained nil encumbrance on its IDBI Bank shareholding throughout FY26.
On 14 October 2026, IDBI Bank reported that its response was awaited regarding a news item on a cabinet stake sale approval.

On 14 October 2026, the CCEA approved M/s 10955230 Canada Inc. (Fairfax Financial Holdings) as strategic buyer of 60.72% of IDBI Bank for ₹52,878 Cr at ₹81 a share, subject to RBI's fit-and-proper clearance.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): interest earned ₹8,519.33 Cr (+19.8% YoY), net profit ₹2,214.45 Cr (-31.4% YoY).
On October 23, 2026, CRISIL Ratings placed IDBI Bank's long-term debt instruments on 'Rating Watch with Positive Implications' and reaffirmed its A1+ rating on the certificate of deposit programme.
On October 26, 2026, ICRA placed IDBI Bank's long-term ratings on Watch with Developing Implications following the proposed ₹52,878 Cr stake acquisition by Fairfax.
